import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Tilde

/-!
# Pullback of associated sheaves on affine schemes

Pulling back an associated sheaf along a morphism of affine spectra agrees
with extension of scalars of the module. The comparison is obtained from the
corresponding global-sections identity by uniqueness of left adjoints.

Adapted from the companion project's `Cohomology/FlatBaseChange.lean`.
This supplies the sheaf realization of the scalar-extension comparison used
in Milne III.1.13.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib

/-- The global-sections comparison commutes with a map of affine spectra. -/
theorem globalSectionsIso_hom_comp_specMap_appTop {R S : CommRingCat.{u}}
    (φ : R ⟶ S) :
    (StructureSheaf.globalSectionsIso ↑R).hom ≫ (Spec.map φ).appTop =
      φ ≫ (StructureSheaf.globalSectionsIso ↑S).hom := by
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫ (Spec.map φ).appTop =
    φ ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).inv
  exact (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality φ).symm

/-- Global sections of an affine pushforward are restriction of scalars of
the original global sections, with their canonical ring actions. -/
noncomputable def gammaPushforwardIso {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S)
    (N : (Spec S).Modules) :
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map φ)).obj N) ≅
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ.hom).obj ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := S)).obj N) := by
  let SecN : ModuleCat ↑((Spec S).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)) :=
    (((SheafOfModules.forgetToSheafModuleCat (Spec S).ringCatSheaf (Opposite.op ⊤)
      (initialOpOfTerminal isTerminalTop)).obj N).obj.obj (Opposite.op ⊤))
  let gsR := (StructureSheaf.globalSectionsIso ↑R).hom.hom
  let gsS := (StructureSheaf.globalSectionsIso ↑S).hom.hom
  let pushTop := ((Spec.map φ).toRingCatSheafHom.hom.app (Opposite.op ⊤)).hom
  have hcomp : pushTop.comp gsR = gsS.comp φ.hom := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro x
    exact congr($(globalSectionsIso_hom_comp_specMap_appTop φ).hom x)
  exact (ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp'App gsR pushTop (pushTop.comp gsR) rfl SecN).symm ≪≫
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalarsCongr hcomp).app SecN ≪≫
    ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp'App φ.hom gsS (gsS.comp φ.hom) rfl SecN

/-- The affine pushforward comparison is natural in the sheaf of modules. -/
noncomputable def gammaPushforwardNatIso {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S) :
    Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map φ) ⋙ moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R) ≅
      moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := S) ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ.hom :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (fun N => gammaPushforwardIso φ N) (by
    intro N N' g
    ext x
    rfl)

/-- The affine pullback comparison is natural in the associated module. -/
noncomputable def pullbackSpecTildeNatIso {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S) :
    tilde.functor R ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ) ≅
      ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom ⋙ tilde.functor S :=
  let adjL := (tilde.adjunction (R := R)).comp
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map φ))
  let adjR := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ.hom).comp (tilde.adjunction (R := S))
  ((conjugateIsoEquiv adjL adjR).symm (gammaPushforwardNatIso φ)).symm

/-- Pullback along an affine spectrum map corresponds to extension of
scalars under the associated-sheaf functor. -/
noncomputable def pullbackSpecTildeIso {R S : CommRingCat.{u}}
    (φ : R ⟶ S) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).obj (tilde M) ≅
      tilde ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).obj M) :=
  (pullbackSpecTildeNatIso φ).app M

/-- The affine pullback comparison intertwines the actual functorial maps. -/
theorem pullbackSpecTildeIso_hom_naturality {R S : CommRingCat.{u}}
    (φ : R ⟶ S) {M N : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map φ)).map ((tilde.functor R).map f) ≫
        (pullbackSpecTildeIso φ N).hom =
      (pullbackSpecTildeIso φ M).hom ≫
        (tilde.functor S).map ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).map f) :=
  (pullbackSpecTildeNatIso φ).hom.naturality f

/-- For an open immersion of affine spectra, actual restriction agrees
with extension of scalars of the associated module. -/
noncomputable def restrictSpecTildeIso {R S : CommRingCat.{u}}
    (φ : R ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map φ)] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    (tilde M).restrict (Spec.map φ) ≅
      tilde ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).obj M) :=
  (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (Spec.map φ)).app (tilde M) ≪≫
    pullbackSpecTildeIso φ M

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The categorical extension of scalars agrees with the usual tensor product. -/
noncomputable def extendScalarsTensorEquiv {R S : CommRingCat.{u}}
    [Algebra R S] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).obj M ≃ₗ[S] (S ⊗[R] M) :=
  by
    let e : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R S)).obj (ModuleCat.of S S) ≃ₗ[R] S :=
      { AddEquiv.refl S with
        map_smul' := fun r s => (Algebra.smul_def r (show S from s)).symm }
    let eTensor := TensorProduct.congr e (LinearEquiv.refl R M)
    exact
      { eTensor.toAddEquiv with
        map_smul' := by
          intro s x
          induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
          | zero => simp
          | tmul t m =>
            change eTensor (s • (t ⊗ₜ[R] m)) = s • eTensor (t ⊗ₜ[R] m)
            simp only [eTensor, TensorProduct.congr_tmul]
            rfl
          | add x y hx hy =>
            change eTensor (s • (x + y)) = s • eTensor (x + y)
            change eTensor (s • x) = s • eTensor x at hx
            change eTensor (s • y) = s • eTensor y at hy
            rw [smul_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, smul_add] }

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
@[simp]
theorem extendScalarsTensorEquiv_tmul {R S : CommRingCat.{u}}
    [Algebra R S] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (s : S) (m : M) :
    extendScalarsTensorEquiv (S := S) M
        ((s : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R S)).obj (ModuleCat.of S S)) ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      s ⊗ₜ[R] m := by
  simp [extendScalarsTensorEquiv]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The tensor identification commutes with extension of module morphisms. -/
theorem extendScalarsTensorEquiv_naturality {R S : CommRingCat.{u}}
    [Algebra R S] {M N : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).map f ≫
        (extendScalarsTensorEquiv (S := S) N).toModuleIso.hom =
      (extendScalarsTensorEquiv (S := S) M).toModuleIso.hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (f.hom.baseChange S) := by
  apply ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext
  intro m
  change extendScalarsTensorEquiv (S := S) N ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] f.hom m) =
    f.hom.baseChange S (extendScalarsTensorEquiv (S := S) M ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] m))
  rw [extendScalarsTensorEquiv_tmul, extendScalarsTensorEquiv_tmul,
    LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]

/-- Pullback of an associated sheaf along an algebra map is the associated
sheaf of the usual tensor product. -/
noncomputable def pullbackSpecTildeTensorIso {R S : CommRingCat.{u}}
    [Algebra R S] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).obj (tilde M) ≅
      tilde (ModuleCat.of S (S ⊗[R] M)) :=
  pullbackSpecTildeIso (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)) M ≪≫
    (tilde.functor S).mapIso (extendScalarsTensorEquiv (S := S) M).toModuleIso

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Affine pullback and scalar extension induce the same associated-sheaf map. -/
theorem pullbackSpecTildeTensorIso_hom_naturality {R S : CommRingCat.{u}}
    [Algebra R S] {M N : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).map
        ((tilde.functor R).map f) ≫ (pullbackSpecTildeTensorIso (S := S) N).hom =
      (pullbackSpecTildeTensorIso (S := S) M).hom ≫
        (tilde.functor S).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (f.hom.baseChange S)) := by
  simp only [pullbackSpecTildeTensorIso, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  erw [← Category.assoc,
    pullbackSpecTildeIso_hom_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)) f,
    Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, extendScalarsTensorEquiv_naturality,
    Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]

/-- Restriction along an open immersion induced by an algebra map is the
associated sheaf of the usual tensor product. -/
noncomputable def restrictSpecTildeTensorIso {R S : CommRingCat.{u}}
    [Algebra R S] [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    (tilde M).restrict (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) ≅
      tilde (ModuleCat.of S (S ⊗[R] M)) :=
  (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).app (tilde M) ≪≫
    pullbackSpecTildeTensorIso M

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Restriction to an affine open commutes with the usual tensor-product map. -/
theorem restrictSpecTildeTensorIso_hom_naturality {R S : CommRingCat.{u}}
    [Algebra R S] [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))]
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).map
        ((tilde.functor R).map f) ≫ (restrictSpecTildeTensorIso (S := S) N).hom =
      (restrictSpecTildeTensorIso (S := S) M).hom ≫
        (tilde.functor S).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (f.hom.baseChange S)) := by
  simp only [restrictSpecTildeTensorIso, Iso.trans_hom]
  erw [← Category.assoc,
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).hom.naturality ((tilde.functor R).map f),
    Category.assoc, pullbackSpecTildeTensorIso_hom_naturality, Category.assoc]

end MilneLib
